description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere with haste.
When the Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myr enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers four times.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers from steps 2 and 4, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any artifact instead using Cogwork Assembler's ability.
Activate Cogwork Assembler three times by paying {7} three times, creating three token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copies of Cogwork Assembler enter the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes three times, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copy of Cogwork Assembler enters the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copy of Cogwork Assembler enters the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Cogwork Assembler with haste.
The token copy of Cogwork Assembler enters the battlefield triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step seven.
